d:
From Mumbai’s chaotic traffic and battered roads to
mist-covered hills and a breathtaking waterfall, Nikhil Bhatia chases the magic of the monsoons in the Renault Duster. This episode of our Terrible Roads to Terrific Places series takes you to the spellbinding reverse waterfall at Naneghat.
Camerapersons: Sharad Vegada, Harshad Panchal
Director: Shahreyar
Editor: Siddhesh Kadam
